requirement.normalizedRequirement: For IA Super without a bulb, compute C_1=f_1*(B*L)/(2*T/B+1)+1.84*(f_2*B+f_3*L+f_4*B*L) and C_2=3.52*(g_1+g_2*B)+g_3*(1+1.2*T/B)*B^2/sqrt(L).
requirement.section: Existing ships of ice class IA Super or IA
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: For ice class IA Super, ship without a bulb, C_1 and C_2 shall be calculated as follows: C_1 = f_1*(B*L)/(2*T/B + 1) + 1.84*(f_2*B + f_3*L + f_4*B*L). C_2 = 3.52*(g_1 + g_2*B) + g_3*(1 + 1.2*T/B)*B^2/sqrt(L).
